label: sec:big-bang-info
html:
At \mathcal{T} = 0, no Reeb operation has occurred. The initial state (bundle initial conditions) specifies fiber data without horizontal transport. No information has propagated. Position is known exactly; momentum is entirely undetermined.

At \mathcal{T} = 1, the first iteration of f_q connects neighboring fibers. The q-connection \nabla_q acts once. Over \mathbb{F}_\pp, this reduces to z_1 = z_0^2 + c(q). The Heisenberg commutator [\hat{X}, \hat{P}]_q = J\hbar_q is near-maximal.

Because t_P \to 1 at the Big Bang, the information-theoretic time \mathcal{T} and the Reeb time coordinate t coincide: t = \hbar_q \mathcal{T} \approx \mathcal{T}. There is no coarse-graining. We resolve each braiding on the exceptional divisor individually. The particle spectrum unfolds step by step through the jet prolongation tower (Planck steps as jet orders).
